name: omnilab/chembl
description: Omnilab ChEMBL: a bioactive molecule by ChEMBL id, InChIKey or name - its type, maximum development phase, computed properties (molecular weight, ALogP, polar surface area, hydrogen bond donors and acceptors, Lipinski's rule of five, QED), SMILES, InChI, structure depiction, mechanisms of action and their targets, and its identifiers in ChEBI, PubChem, UNII and DSSTox through UniChem - and a search by text or InChIKey, through the ChEMBL data web services (EMBL-EBI), no key needed.
